draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: The claim references noise-perturbation results (10%, 20%, 30% noise with drops 0.6, 1.3, 1.8) and table T2, but the research package contains only exp1 on original labels (Table T1). No label-noise experiments or T2 are supplied, so the claim has no evidentiary support.
